query: My karaoke captions look garbled — words run together and sometimes two lines seem printed on top of each other. Timings come straight from the transcript.
expected_behavior: identify two separate causes: overlapping caption windows, and the active-word scale eating the inter-word gap
state that captions are a single slot and windows must be strictly sequential, one frame apart
warn that alternating tracks silences the lint warning without fixing the picture
prescribe per-word padding so the scale grows into padding, not the neighbour
notes: Both defects shipped on the same run and neither raised an error.
